description: The lower decks form a compact residential and utility level aboard the ship. Numbered bunk compartments line both side corridors, while a shared lounge with sofas, chairs and a low table occupies the centre. A blue screen hangs above the lounge, and a darker table area sits below it. The upper stair is labelled To Cargo Hold. Medical/utility lockers lie on the lower left, equipment lockers on the lower right, and an Engineering Access sign marks the bottom. The dark metal panels and warm strip lights frame an orderly grid of small private bays around the shared central space.
